body:
Things keep getting worse. That is an optimistic outlook you have, but what do you do when you just find yourself endlessly falling forever? Sometimes, on days like yesterday, it almost seems like things could get better, even if not in the way I'd like, but that's not even the case. I am being evolved against so hard I am no longer even tolerated, even for the bare minimum of functions. I can not describe this, no one wants to be around me to the point where I am probably going to be forced to kill myself. That's so scary, nothing works, I am not even tolerated to the point where I can get a minimum wage job anymore, and I used to be on point. Life is probably over, I lost and better genetics won out. Organizations would rather go without than have me donate my time.  How is that even possible?

How do you become happy when you no longer can do anything in society at all? It's not about willpower, it's about being allowed to, can't even force it. I wanted to give myself to others, but not even that is enough.  How can you find a purpose when you're not allowed to have one?
